# SYNESIS_E079 — Error

## Description

Field `field_name` (ON BIBLIOGRAPHY) missing in the .bib entry of `author2024`.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
The field `field_name` was declared `REQUIRED ... ON BIBLIOGRAPHY`,
  so its value must come from the SOURCE's `.bib` entry — not from the text.
  But the entry `author2024` has no `field_name` field.
  Add `field_name = {...}` to the entry `author2024` in the
  `.bib` file, or remove the `ON BIBLIOGRAPHY` requirement from the template.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **MissingBibliographyValue**: `field_name`, `bibref`
